headline: Public hearing on National Grid's underground conduit petition for Bow, Wallis, Cabot and Abbott Streets, plus a proposed moratorium on data centers.
summary: The council will consider several grant acceptances, including $45,108 for traffic safety, $2,143,333 for the Massachusetts Task Force 1 site, $66,590.90 for fire station exhaust systems, $58,805 for a fire boat, $430,456 for Lynch Park design, and $25,300 for the Local Cultural Council. It will also take final action on ordinances covering sidewalk obstructions and Human Rights Committee quorum, review GoNetspeed fiber-optic petitions for Virginia Avenue, Charles Street and New Balch Street, and hear requests on Camp Paradise use and traffic safety on Essex and Cole Streets.
